name: Sandstorm
description: Wind-driven sand across the frame. Four sheets of stretched noise slide over one another at different rates so the veil has depth; a much slower gust layer gates them, and where it thickens the sand drags the image along with it.

angle.description: Wind direction, 0..1 mapped over half a turn. Near 0 is a hard cross-frame drive.

smear.description: How far the sand drags the image along the wind.
